title: sonar_nodes
description: One row of public.sonar_nodes. The seeded simulated id is westpoint-cornwall, the same site slug as hydrophone_nodes, with no foreign key between the tables. Poughkeepsie and Tappan Zee are later sites and are not seeded. status defaults to offline when omitted on insert. Realtime is enabled on this table.

id.description: Text primary key. Use the hydrophone site slug when both instruments share a bank.
